S004.answer: at most 2 seconds for 95% of requests
search case, retrieve case and save case
The case officer searches, retrieves and saves cases; each takes at most 2 seconds for 95% of requests with up to 500 concurrent users.

S005.answer: a hardware fault, an interlock trip or an operator emergency stop
The telescope control software commands every subsystem to its safe state within 1 second of detecting a hardware fault, an interlock trip or an operator emergency stop.

S006.answer: for every observation whose instrument configuration changes during the night
The observation scheduler runs the validity check and the feasibility check during operation whenever the instrument configuration changes.
